issue.title: Nav module-level 'const Platform = obsidian.Platform' (c725370) shadows globalThis.Platform, failing bracket-mode-indicator and highlights-hints platform tests
issue.description:
Repo: bob-plugins (linked), master cf25d60.

Three nav unit tests fail deterministically because they simulate a platform by
assigning `globalThis.Platform`, but the nav bundle now resolves `Platform` from a
module-level `const Platform = obsidian.Platform;` in
plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/010-requires-and-config.js (main.js line 24). That
const was added by c725370 "feat(navigation): add Ctrl+W prefix state machine"
(bob-cli-m0.5, epic bob-cli-m0, closed). It shadows the global, so the harness's
`obsidian.Platform` stub (`{ isDesktopApp: true }`) always wins:

- scripts/test-navigation-bracket-mode-indicator.cjs:330 "mobile, non-desktop, or missing status bar mounts nothing and keeps type undefined" (1 !== 0: the indicator still mounts)
- scripts/test-navigation-highlights-hints.cjs:397 "a chip click opens the cached target and never re-resolves" (no click listener: the macOS-only chip never mounts)
- scripts/test-navigation-highlights-hints.cjs:~654 "toggle hides the chip and rail for the session" (chip never becomes is-visible)

Evidence: both files pass 30/30 on a worktree at c725370^ and fail 3 on c725370 and
every later master commit (reported as pre-existing reds by bob-cli-m0 phases and
bob-cli-mc.1 / mc.3 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes, never filed). Found while landing epic
bob-cli-mc.

Fix options: have these tests set `obsidian.Platform` on the harness stub (or pass a
platform override), or drop the module-level const so fragments read Platform through
guarded lookups (the bracket-mode and highlights helpers already check
`obsidian.Platform` then the ambient `Platform`). Check that window-prefix
`windowPrefixIsMacPlatform` and the tab-numeral phone gate still behave. Run
both files plus the window-prefix suites and `npm test`.
